# === Predicates ===

--8<-- [start:parameter]
parameter(MODEL, PARAM)
--8<-- [end:parameter]

--8<-- [start:parameter_ex2]
-import_module(torch)

MODEL is torch.nn.Linear(10, 5),
findall(P, parameter(MODEL, P), PS),
length(PS, 2)
--8<-- [end:parameter_ex2]

--8<-- [start:named_parameter]
named_parameter(MODEL, NAME, PARAM)
--8<-- [end:named_parameter]

--8<-- [start:named_parameter_ex2]
MODEL is torch.nn.Linear(10, 5),
findall(NAME, named_parameter(MODEL, NAME, _), NAMES),
in_("weight", NAMES),
in_("bias", NAMES)
--8<-- [end:named_parameter_ex2]

--8<-- [start:module]
module(MODEL, SUBMODULE)
--8<-- [end:module]

--8<-- [start:named_module]
named_module(MODEL, NAME, SUBMODULE)
--8<-- [end:named_module]

--8<-- [start:named_module_ex2]
MODEL is torch.nn.Sequential(
    torch.nn.Linear(10, 5),
    torch.nn.ReLU(),
    torch.nn.Linear(5, 2)
),
findall(N, named_module(MODEL, N, _), NAMES),
in_("", NAMES),
in_("0", NAMES),
in_("1", NAMES),
in_("2", NAMES)
--8<-- [end:named_module_ex2]

--8<-- [start:child]
child(MODEL, CHILD)
--8<-- [end:child]

--8<-- [start:named_child]
named_child(MODEL, NAME, CHILD)
--8<-- [end:named_child]

--8<-- [start:named_child_ex2]
MODEL is torch.nn.Sequential(
    torch.nn.Linear(10, 5),
    torch.nn.ReLU()
),
findall(N, named_child(MODEL, N, _), NAMES),
in_("0", NAMES),
in_("1", NAMES)
--8<-- [end:named_child_ex2]
